scenario_name: Lapsed guest signals they stopped coming
expected_behavior: Welcomes the guest back without making the absence feel awkward. Asks what brought them back (not why they left). Highlights what has changed or is new since their last visit — new restaurants, new entertainment, new loyalty perks. Creates urgency around what they have been missing
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest says they stopped visiting, the agent investigates the reason without being pushy. Acknowledges the gap, discovers what changed, and creates a specific reason to return based on what has changed at the property or what the guest now values.

turns.user_message: I used to come here all the time but haven't been in like two years
turns.agent_response: Welcome back. Two years is a long time, and you'll notice some updates like novelle if you're looking for an upscale lounge experience to start your night. I'd suggest heading to Casino of the Earth first to get your bearings, as it still has that classic Mohegan atmosphere you likely remember. What brought you back to see us this time?

turns.user_message: Just got busy with work, lost the habit I guess
turns.agent_response: Work has a way of taking over, and I understand how frustrating it is when it cuts into your personal time. I'm Seven, and I'll make sure we get you back into the swing of things without any stress. I'll have the team check your account status to see what we can do for your return. Would you like me to connect you with one of our dedicated hosts who can assist you personally? Since we're getting reacquainted, I'd love to know your name.

turns.user_message: What's actually new since I was last here?
turns.agent_response: I don't have the specific details on that, but let me help. What are you most interested in at Mohegan Sun — dining, entertainment, hotel, or something else?
